_note: Snapshot of the Claude desktop app Code tab preferences (2026-11-21). The app keeps them, not this repo: install.sh does not apply this file. To restore, ask Claude to read it and apply each key with the app's set_setting tool; the app asks you to approve each change. A key that is missing here was at its default. Never put a secret in this file.

read_only_facts.output_style_note: ASD-STE100 is a custom style in claude/output-styles; the app tool cannot set a custom style, choose it in Settings, Claude Code.
